items.item_text: resume
cover letter
Bachelor’s degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
2-3 years of experience in development.
2 years of experience with Tessitura, gift acknowledgment, and reporting.  Campus Alumni and Donor System (CADS) experience is also very helpful.

Working knowledge of fundraising, donor relations, and public relations concepts, principles, procedures, and techniques. Knowledge and experience in the principles, practices, and trends of fundraising.
Experience with Adobe Design Suite.
Experience with event management/coordination.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal skills, and experience in building productive relationships with donors and volunteers.
Assist the Chief Development Officer, Associate Directors of Development, and other portfolio carrying staff in moves management, data, donor engagement, scheduling, and other duties.
As assigned, manage donor stewardship including escorting sponsors back-stage, greeting at receptions, acknowledgment letters, stewardship events support, communications and calendar.
As appropriate, collaborate with and support the Chief Development Officer, Associate Directors of Development, and other donor-facing staff who determine individualized fundraising strategies.
Compose and prepare fundraising proposals for donors as needed.
Manage Patron Sponsor solicitations and benefits such as comp tickets, meet and greets, thank you gifts including photos, signed programs, awards, etc.
Manage and maintain accurate donor recognition, including but not limited to program book credits, maintaining the funder credit grid, and website donor credits.

Support events tailored to the cultivation and stewardship of prospects, trustees, and donors while being grounded in the organization’s fundraising priorities for the season such as gala, pre- or post-dinners, cultivation events, intermission receptions, Home Concerts, and Trustee events. Partner with other staff to follow up after fundraising events and finalize gift fulfilment.
Support budget team managers by processing for vendor purchase order requests, invoices, entertainment forms, reimbursements, and as departmental lead to coordinate with finance team.
Collaborate to manage department comp ticket and parking allocation and distribution for all performances in coordination with the ticket office in a timely and accurate manner.

Serve as a liaison, among other development staff, to operations by attending operations meetings when needed and effectively communicating donor event logistics, needs, and details. Problem-solve operational needs such as large backstage visits. Ensure timely and accurate entry of event details into database resources.
Provide technical assistance and support for board and other meetings as needed.
Act as departmental liaison to follow gift processing practices and procedures and ensure, in collaboration with other staff, accurate records and recording of gifts.
Collaborate effectively with departmental staff to create slide materials and presentations for digital and print presentation.
Act as proofer for routed copy used in external communications.
Create templates for email communications for events and annual campaigns in coordination with staff leading these efforts.

Maintain and manage specialized email accounts including the incoming donor inquiries inbox and events inbox, effectively communicating with other staff to ensure a seamless and appropriate stream of timely communications in response to questions, requests, and RSVPs.

In collaboration with designated UDAR prospect development staff, serve as department specialist in prospect research needs. This includes utilizing wealth screening tools, identifying prospective supporters from ticket population, UCB alumni and affiliates, and through on- and off-line media with capacity and interest in programmatic support areas.
Write confidential prospect profiles and briefings to prepare fundraisers and staff for visits, events, and solicitations.
Provide weekly reports to fundraisers on prospect movement, reflecting and tracking fundraising progress and strategies.
Ensure that portfolios are current in CADS and Tessitura, enter gifts, contact reports, and provide moves management updates.
Maintain and develop administrative support systems, including thorough documentation of procedures, solicitation, acknowledgment, and stewardship materials.

Support board committees in their efforts as assigned, including updating board handbook, attending committee meetings, preparing and distributing meeting minutes and materials in advance of meetings, and responding to board needs for development support.
Passion for the performing arts.
Ability to exercise flexibility, initiative, good judgment, and discretion.  Ability to maintain confidentiality.
Excellent problem-solving skills; must be detail-oriented and able to work effectively with personnel within and outside the department.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team to set and coordinate priorities and manage multiple projects to meet internal and external competing deadlines; ability to work under pressure.  Flexibility to meet changing needs and priorities.
Excellent computer skills and facility with MS Office, including Microsoft Word and Excel, and Google’s suite.  Ability to learn new software programs as required.
Ability to work nights and weekends as required.
Ability to successfully pass a background check.
